meet.speaker: leevee
meet.text: Oh. Detective. I’m returning Skye’s journals before they’re overdue. She hates late fees more than she hates the cold.

a.speaker: leevee
a.text: Still here? The journals are nearly shelved.

choices.text: Why are you returning her books?
What were you cleaning at her place?
The bartender says you came in after her.

books.speaker: leevee
books.text: She checks out more than she reads. I bring them back so the library keeps letting her.

counter.speaker: leevee
counter.text: I had a dishcloth. There was a red mark on the counter. That’s all I saw.

counter2.speaker: leevee
counter2.text: Like salsa. Or jam. I didn’t taste it, detective. I’m a cleaning routine, not a food critic.

bar.speaker: leevee
bar.text: I went in after her. The bartender had already handed over her order.

choices.text: Where did she go after that?

bar2.speaker: leevee
bar2.text: Toward the tower, both arms full. I came here instead. Somebody has to return the journals.

end.speaker: leevee
end.text: Good luck, detective. I’ll finish shelving these in the back.
